metaDescription: Vercel is a cloud platform for deploying web apps and AI agents, with Git-based CI/CD, preview deployments, Fluid compute and a global CDN. See its features, Hobby, Pro and Enterprise pricing, strengths, limitations and alternatives.
overview: Vercel is a cloud platform for deploying and scaling web applications. Import a Git repository and Vercel builds and deploys it automatically, with a preview URL for every push, a global CDN, automatic HTTPS and serverless functions. Vercel also maintains the Next.js framework.

Functions run on Fluid compute, which is billed by active CPU time and reuses instances to cut costs. Vercel also offers infrastructure for AI apps and agents, including the AI SDK, an AI Gateway to hundreds of models, sandboxes and v0, its AI app builder. The Hobby plan is free; Pro adds team collaboration and a monthly usage credit, with usage billed on demand after that.

features.title: Git-based deploys
features.text: Automatic CI/CD from GitHub and other Git providers, with HTTPS on every deployment.

features.title: Preview deployments
features.text: Every pull request gets its own URL on production-equivalent infrastructure.

features.title: Fluid compute
features.text: Serverless functions billed by active CPU, with concurrency and minimal cold starts.

features.title: Global CDN and firewall
features.text: A global CDN with DDoS mitigation and a Web Application Firewall.

features.title: AI infrastructure
features.text: The AI SDK, an AI Gateway to hundreds of models, sandboxes and durable workflows.

features.title: v0
features.text: Vercel's AI app builder that generates apps and deploys them to Vercel (paid add-on).

useCases: Hosting Next.js and other frontend frameworks
Preview environments for every pull request
strengths: Very fast setup: import a repo and deploy in seconds.
Preview URLs for every pull request.
Made by the team behind Next.js, with first-class support.
A free Hobby plan with 100 GB of Fast Data Transfer.
limitations: Pro is $20/mo per seat, plus on-demand usage beyond the included $20 credit.
Usage-based pricing across many metrics can be harder to predict.
Hobby has fixed usage limits rather than on-demand billing.
Some features, such as v0, are paid add-ons.
Contractual SLAs and multi-region compute need Enterprise.

pricing.summary: Free Hobby plan. Pro includes a monthly usage credit, then bills usage on demand. Prices are in USD and exclude taxes. Pro has a 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Hobby
plans.note: Git deploys · previews · HTTPS · 100 GB Fast Data Transfer · included usage limits

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: $20 usage credit included · team collaboration · free viewer seats · spend management

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Contractual SLAs · multi-region compute · advanced access controls · dedicated support
